purpose: Add trustworthy scope-bound evidence memory so N0TE remembers the right fact at the right Artist/Song/version scope, preserves provenance, surfaces conflict, and reconciles only by explicit supersession.

lineage.outcome: N0TE remembers evidence at the correct scope and never invents a winner when active evidence conflicts.
lineage.capability: Scoped evidence memory + provenance + truthful conflict/reconciliation

completion_proof: Song-scoped evidence never resolves for another Song
version evidence applies only to its own version and more-specific scope wins only by scope
source kind/reference and confidence survive restart
contradictory active values at the same applicable scope return CONFLICT with no selected value
multiple sources agreeing on the same value resolve while preserving all evidence
explicit reconciliation appends a new claim and supersedes prior active same-key/same-scope claims without deleting history
cross-scope or cross-key supersession is rejected
tampered scope references fail visibly on evidence open
all behavior remains inside the canonical profile lineage database with no context sidecar store
non_scope: Technical Twin / Creative Twin consumer experience
next_selection_rule: After CORE-01B proof, reconcile evidence and reselect from the whole remaining CORE-01/customer hierarchy. Do not continue evidence tables by adjacency.
